title: Saint Bartholomew's Cemetery & Vale Mortuary
intent: A bounded burial ground is organized by a main avenue and memorial ring. Ruined chapel and caretaker cottage face the approach; two ossuary entrances join underground. Add the adjoining Vale Mortuary as a separately reviewed east-side annex; the original cemetery packet remains the source of truth until this expansion is accepted.

staging.logistics: Van is already staged on a prepared roadhead/service apron through expedition logistics. Travel to this remote region is a campaign transition; no new vehicle, ferry or flight gameplay is assumed.

circulation: Avenue and marker ring provide two surface search loops. Both underground vestibules have full stairs with matching openings; the record chamber is a short branch. Headstones remain fixed sightline objects across all detail settings.
systems: Tree cover, wind, surface water and enclosed stone passages have distinct sound/temperature baselines. Memorial records offer narrative rather than a magic detector reading.
campaign: Numbered markers, caretaker succession and missing parish entries connect provisionally to St. Brigid and Ashen Bells. Ordinary burial and remembrance are not implied sources of evil.
refine: Research burial-ground circulation and ossuary structure before detailed construction; keep fictional history explicit.
Place no rites on graves or inaccessible marker tops; all reservation squares are on clear paths/floors.
Test underground exit visibility and tree-occlusion consistency.
Original cemetery geometry and ritual reservations are retained byte-for-byte in its separate source packet.
Review mortuary room hygiene/service separation before detailed dressing; use appropriate purpose-built fixtures.
sources: User-requested mortuary extension, 23 October 2026; specialist architectural reference and detailed fixture dimensions still pending.

terrain.description: Retain original cemetery terrain; annex foundation and east retaining bank are additive reservations, with a shallow approach swale.

needed_models: Purpose-built mortuary preparation table, sink and cold-storage doors
Viewing-room seating, curtains and discreet memorial furniture
Reception desk, document cabinets, office furniture and supported paperwork
Discreet service bay, trolley and screened approach
Annex shell, roof/drainage, sealed partitions and mortuary fixtures

saved_editor_terrain.remaining: Retaining/foundation rims, guards, arrival/canonical van, source-specific terrain finish and complete movement/visual acceptance

basement_entry_revision.purpose: Eliminate diagonal stair crossings through the vestibule wall/header at the wrong elevation. Retain both basement entrances and all existing room IDs/search-space counts.
basement_entry_revision.upper_landing_clearance: 2m approaches turn on intact vestibule floor before the1.5m stair opening; actual standing anchors lie at the matched stair tops, not the old room centres.
